method: OA21 best-fit crosswalk. July 2024 constituencies; April 2023 local authorities. Every represented TTWA retained, including explicit outside-atlas codes. Named places use OS Open Names representative points tested against original TTWA polygons in British National Grid. Postcodes use Postcodes.io ONS TTWA codes.
needMethod: Existing IMD2025 neighbourhood population share, mid-2022 population. LSOAs crossing TTWAs allocated by constituent OA shares. Fraction multiplied by 100 for display only.
